layout.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8, p-12, p-16) for sections. Mobile-first grids.

components.buttons: Rounded-md, crisp edges. Primary uses #F26A2E background with white text, hover state with lighter hue. Must have data-testid.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
components.navigation: Sticky header (z-50) using Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80) with a 1px bottom border. Visible links on desktop. Logo prominent.
components.footer: Dark background (#0B2046) with light text. Massive spacing (py-20).
components.forms: Use Shadcn components, heavily customized to match earthy theme. Use off-white backgrounds, slightly rounded corners. No default Vercel look.

motion.hover: Smooth transform 0.2s ease on all interactables.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for bento grid and lists using framer-motion.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Outfit and Manrope fonts from Google Fonts via tailwind.config.js or css imports.
Implement guest booking flow using Shadcn Forms, capturing name, age, number of members.
Integrate Razorpay checkout for payment flow. Since actual Razorpay may require auth, implement a mocked integration that simulates the payment overlay.
Implement the WhatsApp redirection upon successful booking using the wa.me api.
Design Trek Detail page using a sticky right-side column for the Booking Card, and a left side for details and bento image gallery.
The Hero section must use the provided image with a gradient overlay (bg-black/40) so the text is highly visible.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements.
Build the admin panel using a clean, dense dashboard style with #FDFBF7 background and 1px borders. Use the 'Control Room' grid.
